The operating company directly providing the **ActiveCampaign** software product at **activecampaign.com** is **ActiveCampaign, LLC**.

### Provider Statement
According to the official ActiveCampaign Terms of Service:
> *"These Terms of Service (“Terms”) apply to your access to and use of the websites, applications and other products and services, including email services, trainings, events, marketing services, consulting services, review and message boards and various other message communication applications (collectively, our “Services”) provided by ActiveCampaign, LLC. (“ActiveCampaign”, “we”, or “us”)."*
